text: In the 24000-step N=64 seed-23 run, layer-1 force is flat (0.831-0.835) from step 3000 to step 12000 and then gains about 0.013 over steps 12000-24000, while val_mse_ratio falls from 0.007 to 0.0009. Is that late force gain tied to the decaying-lr tail, or to val_mse_ratio dropping below about 0.005? Comparing at matched schedule fraction against the 12000-step run (step 6000 vs step 12000) would tell these apart.
